sender.en: A courier or the post: “BH Pošta”, “EuroExpress”, “DHL”

name.bs: Lažni SMS kurira ili pošte: „paket ne može biti dostavljen“
name.en: Fake courier or post text: “your parcel can’t be delivered”

how.bs: Stiže SMS, često sa stranog broja, u ime kurirske službe ili pošte: paket čeka, ali ne može biti isporučen zbog adrese, carine ili male doplate. Link vodi na kopiju stranice kurira koja traži lične podatke i podatke kartice. Tekst ima čudne znakove, greške ili neprirodne rečenice.
how.en: A text arrives, often from a foreign number, in the name of a courier or the post: a parcel is waiting but can’t be delivered because of the address, customs or a small extra fee. The link leads to a copy of the courier’s site that asks for personal and card details. The text has odd characters, mistakes or unnatural sentences.

text.en: A “courier” text: your parcel is held.

text.bs: Link na stranicu koja nije službena stranica kurira.
text.en: A link to a page that isn’t the courier’s official site.

text.bs: Treba platiti sitnu doplatu ili carinu.
text.en: You must pay a small fee or customs duty.
They ask for your card number and CVC.

text.bs: EuroExpress: Vasa posiljka je zadrzana u skladistu zbog nepotpune adrese. Za ponovnu dostavu potrebno je platiti 2,50 KM u roku od 24h: [link]
text.en: EuroExpress: Your shipment is held at the warehouse because of an incomplete address. Re-delivery requires a payment of 2.50 KM within 24 hours: [link]

bs: sms paket ne može biti dostavljen
poruka kurira doplata za dostavu link
en: text saying my parcel can’t be delivered
courier message with delivery fee link
fake dhl customs message asking for card

bs: Kuriri i pošta ne traže podatke kartice preko linka u SMS-u.
Poruka sa stranog broja, s greškama i čudnim znakovima.
Kratak rok i mali iznos koji „nije vrijedan“ provjere.
en: Couriers and the post don’t ask for card details through a link in a text.
A message from a foreign number, with mistakes and odd characters.
A short deadline and a small amount that seems “not worth” checking.

bs: Ne otvarajte link. Pošiljku provjerite na službenoj stranici ili aplikaciji kurira, upisujući adresu sami.
Ako ste unijeli podatke kartice, odmah zovite banku radi blokade.
en: Don’t open the link. Check the parcel on the courier’s official site or app, typing the address yourself.
If you entered card details, call your bank at once to block the card.
Report the message to the police.
